subject: How to create a table with reactive links

messages.author: 71335e4c86a7e748
messages.subject: How to create a table with reactive links
parts:
Hi, I'm trying to achieve the following

Suppose I have a table which I display in Shiny. This table measures some values for a specific item (say sales for a location, pnl for a stock, etc). I want the user to be able to click in the id for that row (the name of the location or the ticker of the stock) and then display a new table (maybe in a new tab) which explains how the sales or the pnl is calculated, and therefore includes all the sales in that location or all the trades in that stock.

Is this possible actually?

Thanks!

messages.author: 2ed19a7addb843f5
messages.subject: Re: How to create a table with reactive links
parts:
Two options off the top of my head:

1. If the size of your table is small, you can pre-generate HTML pages and then link to them from the table. This can all be done automatically (give the page a name related to the ID in the table and then construct a link to it). This becomes problematic when you have to pre-generate a lot of pages that might not be used.

2. You might be able to link to a different shiny app and pass the argument in the session information, and parse this in the second shiny app
